blocks.text: Jerome writes to a lady of Gaul named Algasia to answer eleven questions which she had submitted to him. They were as follows:—
(1) How is Luke 7:18, 19, to be reconciled with John i. 36?
(2) What is the meaning of Matt. xii. 20?
(6) What is the meaning of the parable of the unjust steward?
(7) What is the meaning of Rom. v. 7?
The date of the letter is 406 A.D.
